name: Acceltra
description: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.

name: Acceltra Prime
description: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.

name: Ack & Brunt
description: Tyl Regor's custom axe and shield are how he likes to eliminate ‘frustrations'.

name: Acrid
description: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.

name: Aegrit
description: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.

name: Aeolak
description: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.

name: Afentis
description: Styanax’s speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.

name: Afentis Prime
description: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.

name: Afuris
description: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.

name: Afuris Prime
description: Vanquish chaos with dual firepower.

name: Agkuza
description: Tear apart incoming enemies with this massive hooked blade.

name: Akarius
description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.

name: Akarius Prime
description: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.

name: Akbolto
description: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.

name: Akbolto Prime
description: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.

name: Akbronco
description: A Bronco equipped in each hand.

name: Akbronco Prime
description: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.

name: Akjagara
description: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.

name: Akjagara Prime
description: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.

name: Aklato
description: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.

name: Aklex
description: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.

name: Aklex Prime
description: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.

name: Akmagnus
description: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.

name: Akmagnus Prime
description: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.

name: Aksomati
description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.

name: Aksomati Prime
description: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.

name: Akstiletto
description: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.

name: Akstiletto Prime
description: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.

name: Akvasto
description: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.

name: Akvasto Prime
description: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.

name: Akzani
description: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.

name: Alternox
description: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.

name: Alternox Prime
description: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.

name: Amanata
description: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.

name: Ambassador
description: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.

name: Amphis
description: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.

name: Amprex
description: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.

name: Angstrum
description: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.

name: Anku
description: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.

name: Ankyros
description: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.

name: Ankyros Prime
description: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.

name: Arbucep
description: Nokko’s signature archgun fires six homing missiles, each bearing a payload of one of the six combined elements which detonate in an area upon impact.

name: Arca Plasmor
description: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

name: Arca Scisco
description: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.

name: Arca Titron
description: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.

name: Argo & Vel
description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

name: Argonak
description: Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.

name: Arum Spinosa
description: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.

name: Ash
description: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.

abilities.name: Shuriken
abilities.description: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.

abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.description: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.description: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.

name: Ash Prime
description: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

name: Astilla
description: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.

name: Astilla Prime
description: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.

name: Athodai
description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.

name: Athodai Prime
description: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on headshot kills, maximizing fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.

name: Atlas
description: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.

abilities.name: Landslide
abilities.description: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.

abilities.name: Tectonics
abilities.description: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.

abilities.name: Petrify
abilities.description: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.

abilities.name: Rumblers
abilities.description: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.

name: Atlas Prime
description: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.

name: Atomos
description: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.

name: Atterax
description: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.

name: Attica
description: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.

name: Ax-52
description: This pre-Orokin weapon earned its popularity for its reliability in tough conditions. When hip-firing, its Ammo Efficiency increases. When aiming, headshots have a high Critical Chance.

name: Azima
description: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.

name: Azothane
description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

name: Ballistica
description: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.

name: Ballistica Prime
description: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.

name: Banshee
description: Banshee’s call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.

abilities.name: Sonic Boom
abilities.description: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.

abilities.name: Sonar
abilities.description: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.description: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.

abilities.name: Sound Quake
abilities.description: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.

name: Banshee Prime
description: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

name: Baruuk
description: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.

abilities.name: Elude
abilities.description: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.

abilities.name: Lull
abilities.description: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.

abilities.name: Desolate Hands
abilities.description: Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.

abilities.name: Serene Storm
abilities.description: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.

name: Baruuk Prime
description: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.

name: Basmu
description: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.

name: Battacor
description: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.

name: Baza
description: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.

name: Baza Prime
description: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.

name: Bo
description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.

name: Bo Prime
description: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.

name: Boar
description: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.

name: Boar Prime
description: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.

name: Boltace
description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.

name: Bolto
description: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

name: Boltor
description: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

name: Boltor Prime
description: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.

name: Bonewidow
description: This fearsome Necramech, fashioned in honor of the Entrati matriarch, is a robust front-line fighter. Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.

abilities.name: Meathook
abilities.description: Skewer and hold a target, siphoning their health. Use again to hurl the victim damaging them and anyone near the impact site.

abilities.name: Shield Maiden
abilities.description: Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage, reflecting it back at attackers. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.

abilities.name: Firing Line
abilities.description: Sweep surrounding enemies into the line of fire and suspend them in air with a force beam.

abilities.name: Exalted Ironbride
abilities.description: Summon a devastating exalted blade.

name: Brakk
description: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.

name: Braton
description: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.

name: Braton Prime
description: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.

name: Braton Vandal
description: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

name: Broken Scepter
description: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.

name: Broken War
description: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.

name: Bronco
description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.

name: Bronco Prime
description: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.

name: Bubonico
description: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.

name: Burston
description: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.

name: Burston Prime
description: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.

name: Buzlok
description: Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.

name: Cadus
description: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.

name: Caliban
description: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.

abilities.name: Razor Gyre
abilities.description: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.

abilities.name: Sentient Wrath
abilities.description: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.

abilities.name: Lethal Progeny
abilities.description: Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.

abilities.name: Fusion Strike
abilities.description: Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.

name: Caliban Prime
description: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.

name: Cantare
description:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

name: Carmine Penta
description: Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.

name: Cassowar
description: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.

name: Castanas
description: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.

name: Catabolyst
description: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.

name: Caustacyst
description: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.

name: Cedo
description: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire’s precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.

name: Cedo Prime
description: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.

name: Centaur
description: Part sword, part shield, the Centaur excels at charging headlong into enemy fire.

name: Ceramic Dagger
description: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.

name: Cerata
description: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.

name: Cernos
description: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.

name: Cernos Prime
description: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.

name: Cestra
description: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.

name: Ceti Lacera
description: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.

name: Chroma
description: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.

abilities.name: Spectral Scream
abilities.description: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.

abilities.name: Elemental Ward
abilities.description: Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.

abilities.name: Vex Armor
abilities.description: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.

abilities.name: Effigy
abilities.description: Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.

name: Chroma Prime
description: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

name: Cinta
description: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.

name: Citrine
description: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.

abilities.name: Fractured Blast
abilities.description: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.

abilities.name: Preserving Shell
abilities.description: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.

abilities.name: Prismatic Gem
abilities.description: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.

abilities.name: Crystallize
abilities.description: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.

name: Cobra & Crane
description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.

name: Cobra & Crane Prime
description: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.

name: Coda Bassocyst
description: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.

name: Coda Bubonico
description: With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.

name: Coda Catabolyst
description: When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.

name: Coda Caustacyst
description: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.

name: Coda Hema
description: The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

name: Coda Hirudo
description: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.

name: Coda Mire
description: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.

name: Coda Motovore
description: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.

name: Coda Pathocyst
description: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.

name: Coda Pox
description: These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

name: Coda Sporothrix
description: Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.

name: Coda Synapse
description: Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.

name: Coda Tysis
description: The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.

name: Convectrix
description: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.

name: Corinth
description: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.

name: Corinth Prime
description: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.

name: Cortege
description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy flamethrower with surprising range. Secondary fire launches three projectiles in a fan pattern that explode, leaving a damaging area of effect for a short duration.

name: Corufell
description: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.

name: Corvas
description: When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.

name: Corvas Prime
description: Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.

name: Cronus
description: A strong blade forged using ceramic.

name: Cyanex
description: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.

name: Cycron
description: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.

name: Cyngas
description: Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.

name: Cyte-09
description: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.

abilities.name: Seek
abilities.description: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.

abilities.name: Resupply
abilities.description:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon’s magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.

abilities.name: Evade
abilities.description: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.

abilities.name: Neutralize
abilities.description: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.

name: Dagath
description: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.

abilities.name: Wyrd Scythes
abilities.description: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.

abilities.name: Doom
abilities.description: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.

abilities.name: Grave Spirit
abilities.description: Supercharge Dagath's weapons with extra Critical Damage. The effects are doubled on Doomed enemies. Escape fatal blows by briefly assuming a spectral form.

abilities.name: Rakhali's Cavalry
abilities.description: Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.

name: Daikyu
description: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.

name: Daikyu Prime
description: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.

name: Dakra Prime
description: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.

name: Dante
description: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.

abilities.name: Noctua
abilities.description: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.

abilities.name: Light Verse
abilities.description: Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.

abilities.name: Dark Verse
abilities.description: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.

abilities.name: Final Verse
abilities.description:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally’s attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.

name: Dark Dagger
description: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.

name: Dark Split-Sword
description: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.

name: Dark Sword
description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.

name: Dera
description: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.

name: Dera Vandal
description: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.

name: Despair
description: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.

name: Destreza
description: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.

name: Destreza Prime
description: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.

name: Detron
description: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.

name: Dex Dakra
description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

name: Dex Furis
description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

name: Dex Nikana
description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

name: Dex Sybaris
description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

name: Dorrclave
description: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.

name: Dragon Nikana
description: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.

name: Drakgoon
description: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

name: Dread
description: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.

name: Dual Cestra
description: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.

name: Dual Cleavers
description: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.

name: Dual Coda Torxica
description: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.

name: Dual Decurion
description: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.

name: Dual Ether
description: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.

name: Dual Heat Swords
description: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.

name: Dual Ichor
description: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.

name: Dual Kamas
description: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.

name: Dual Kamas Prime
description: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.

name: Dual Keres
description: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.

name: Dual Keres Prime
description: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.

name: Dual Raza
description: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.

name: Dual Skana
description: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.

name: Dual Toxocyst
description: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.

name: Dual Viciss
description: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.

name: Dual Zoren
description: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

name: Dual Zoren Prime
description: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.

name: Edun
description: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

name: Efv-5 Jupiter
description: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.

name: Efv-8 Mars
description: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.

name: Ekhein
description: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.

name: Ember
description: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.description: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.description: Protect Ember with flame armor that burns stronger over time, consuming energy once its meter is at full strength. Cast again to extinguish the flame.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.description: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.description: Command a flaming comet to crash down in front of Ember, engulfing enemies with a fire that can spread through their ranks.

name: Ember Prime
description: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.

name: Endura
description: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.

name: Enkaus
description: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.

name: Epitaph
description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

name: Epitaph Prime
description: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.

name: Equinox
description: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.description: Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.

abilities.name: Rest & Rage
abilities.description: In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.

abilities.name: Pacify & Provoke
abilities.description: In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.

abilities.name: Mend & Maim
abilities.description: In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.

name: Equinox Prime
description: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.

description: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.

name: Ether Reaper
description: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.

name: Ether Sword
description: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing’ infested allies.

name: Euphona Prime
description: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.

name: Evensong
description:
Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong's arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

name: Excalibur
description: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.

abilities.name: Slash Dash
abilities.description: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.

abilities.name: Radial Blind
abilities.description: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Radial Javelin
abilities.description: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.

abilities.name: Exalted Blade
abilities.description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.

description: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.

name: Falcor
description: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.

name: Fang
description: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.

name: Fang Prime
description: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.

name: Felarx
description: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.

name: Ferrox
description: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.

name: Fluctus
description: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.

name: Flux Rifle
description: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.

name: Follie
description: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.

abilities.name: Forced Perspective
abilities.description: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Shadowgraph
abilities.description:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.

abilities.name: Self Portrait
abilities.description: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.

abilities.name: Plein Air
abilities.description: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.

name: Fragor
description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

name: Fragor Prime
description: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.

name: Frost
description: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost’s attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.

abilities.name: Freeze
abilities.description: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.

abilities.name: Ice Wave
abilities.description: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.

abilities.name: Snow Globe
abilities.description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.description: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.

name: Furax
description: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.

description: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.

name: Furis
description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.

name: Fusilai
description: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.

name: Galariak Prime
description: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.

name: Galatine
description: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.

name: Galatine Prime
description: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.

name: Galvacord
description: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.

name: Gammacor
description: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.

name: Gara
description: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.

abilities.name: Shattered Lash
abilities.description: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.

abilities.name: Splinter Storm
abilities.description: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.

abilities.name: Spectrorage
abilities.description: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.

abilities.name: Mass Vitrify
abilities.description: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. description: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.

name: Glaive
description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.

name: Glaive Prime
description: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.

name: Glaxion
description: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.

name: Glaxion Vandal
description: A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.

name: Gorgon
description: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.

name: Gorgon Wraith
description: The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.

name: Gotva Prime
description: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect, its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.

name: Grakata
description: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.

name: Gram
description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.

name: Gram Prime
description: Born anew, the father of swords returns.

name: Grattler
description: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.

name: Grendel
description: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.description: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.

abilities.name: Nourish
abilities.description: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.

abilities.name: Pulverize
abilities.description: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.

abilities.name: Regurgitate
abilities.description: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.

name: Grendel Prime
description: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.

name: Grimoire
description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.

name: Grinlok
description: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.

name: Guandao
description: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.

name: Guandao Prime
description: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.

name: Gunsen
description: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.

name: Gunsen Prime
description: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.

name: Gyre
description: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.

abilities.name: Arcsphere
abilities.description: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.

abilities.name: Coil Horizon
abilities.description: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.

abilities.name: Cathode Grace
abilities.description: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.

abilities.name: Rotorswell
abilities.description: Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.

name: Gyre Prime
description: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.

description: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.

name: Halikar
description: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.

name: Halikar Wraith
description: A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.

name: Harmony
description:
Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

name: Harpak
description: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.

name: Harrow
description: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.

abilities.name: Penance
abilities.description: Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.

abilities.name: Thurible
abilities.description: Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Headshots produce extra energy.

abilities.name: Covenant
abilities.description: Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Headshots are amplified even further.

name: Harrow Prime
description: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.

name: Heat Dagger
description: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.

name: Heat Sword
description: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.

name: Hek
description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.

name: Heliocor
description: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

abilities.name: Energized Munitions
abilities.description: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.

abilities.name: Master's Summons
abilities.description: Heal your companion and call it to your side.

abilities.name: Voracious Metastasis
abilities.description: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.

abilities.name: Perspicacity
abilities.description: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.

abilities.name: Sickening Pulse
abilities.description: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer

abilities.name: Hideous Resistance
abilities.description: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.

abilities.name: Parasitic Armor
abilities.description: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.

abilities.name: Rebuild Shields
abilities.description: Instantly restore your shields.

abilities.name: Infested Mobility
abilities.description: Increase your parkour velocity.

abilities.name: Expedite Suffering
abilities.description: Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.description: Increase the strength of your next ability use.

abilities.name: Marked For Death
abilities.description: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.

abilities.name: Golden Instinct
abilities.description: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.

name: Hema
description: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.

name: Hespar
description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.

name: Higasa
description: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.

name: Hikou
description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.

name: Hikou Prime
description: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.

name: Hildryn
description: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.

abilities.name: Balefire
abilities.description: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.

abilities.name: Pillage
abilities.description: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.

abilities.name: Haven
abilities.description: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.

abilities.name: Aegis Storm
abilities.description: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.

name: Hildryn Prime
description: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.

abilities.name: Tidal Surge
abilities.description: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.

abilities.name: Tentacle Swarm
abilities.description: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.

name: Hystrix Prime
description: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.

name: Ignis
description: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.

name: Ignis Wraith
description: A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.

name: Imperator
description: A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.

name: Imperator Vandal
description: The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.

name: Inaros
description: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.

abilities.name: Desiccation
abilities.description: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.

abilities.name: Sandstorm
abilities.description: Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.

abilities.name: Scarab Shell
abilities.description: Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.

abilities.name: Scarab Swarm
abilities.description: Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.

description: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.

name: Ivara
description: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.

abilities.name: Quiver
abilities.description: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.

abilities.name: Navigator
abilities.description: Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.

abilities.name: Prowl
abilities.description: Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.

abilities.name: Artemis Bow
abilities.description: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.

abilities.description: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.

abilities.name: Symphony Of Mercy
abilities.description: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.

abilities.name: Ophanim Eyes
abilities.description: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.

abilities.name: Glory On High
abilities.description: Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.

name: Jat Kittag
description: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.

name: Jat Kusar
description: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.

name: Javlok
description: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.

name: Jaw Sword
description: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.

name: Kama
description: The Kama is a Tenno style hatchet, capable of making short work of any foe.

name: Karak
description: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.

name: Karak Wraith
description: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.

name: Karyst
description: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.

name: Karyst Prime
description: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.

name: Kaszas
description: Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.

name: Keratinos
description: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.

name: Kesheg
description: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.

name: Kestrel
description: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.

name: Kestrel Prime
description: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.

name: Khora
description: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.

abilities.name: Whipclaw
abilities.description: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.

abilities.name: Ensnare
abilities.description: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.

abilities.name: Venari
abilities.description: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.

abilities.name: Strangledome
abilities.description: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.

name: Khora Prime
description: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.
